source.title: Portugal D7 Passive Income Visa Requirements Reference

taxonomy_fields.label: Are you applying as an individual or with family dependents?
Are you applying from your country of nationality?
Is your lawful residence in the country where you will apply valid beyond the requested visa period?
What type of income or financial resources will you rely on to support yourself in Portugal?
What is the total amount in EUR of passive income or other own financial resources you can use to support yourself during your first year in Portugal?
taxonomy_fields.description: Portugal D7 screening uses the 2026 minimum monthly salary of EUR 920 and a 12-month main-applicant threshold of EUR 11,040.

taxonomy_fields.label: Which documents can you provide as evidence of your income or financial resources?
How many dependents are included in your application?
What is each dependent's relationship to you?
How many included dependents are additional adults?
How many included dependents are children under 18 or dependent adult children?
How many months will your passport be valid from your intended Portugal application or entry date?
Will you have accommodation available in Portugal for at least 12 months?
Which best describes your health or travel insurance for Portugal?
taxonomy_fields.description: Coverage must include medical expenses, urgent medical assistance, and possible repatriation, unless a bilateral healthcare agreement applies.

taxonomy_fields.label: Can you obtain the required criminal record certificate from your country of nationality and any country where you have lived for more than 1 year?
Do you have any criminal convictions that may appear on a background check?
What else about your Portugal D7 Passive Income Visa situation should QIQ consider?

post_eligibility_checklist.note: This is a real Portugal D7 requirement sourced from requirements_reference.md, but it describes a post-approval residence step rather than a fact needed to determine INITIAL visa eligibility. It was removed from the live eligibility-screening flow and is preserved here for a future post-eligibility guidance surface. Its former requirement code still exists in clarifications.json for that purpose.

fields.label: Do you understand that after D7 visa approval, you must request a residence title from AIMA during the residence stage?
